primary.title: Facing an NPS-related issue? Know how to raise a complaint through the PFRDA Pension Sahayak portal
primary.summary: Have an NPS or APY-related query or complaint? PFRDA’s Pension Sahayak offers a simpler way for subscribers to raise and track grievances online. Here’s how the platform works, the steps to register a complaint, and what happens if the issue remains unresolved.
